entries.title: An answer to your post sits near the bottom of the bell and queue; the Messaging link has no unread count
entries.rootCause: neos_agent/services/next_steps.py:837-841 _queue_order sorts overdue, then OWNER_ACTIONS (:83-84), then dated before undated; read_response is built undated with overdue=False (:1462-1466), so every dated advice/consent item outranks it. approve_collaboration (:1516-1521) and respond_to_audit (:1207-1211) are also undated and not in OWNER_ACTIONS. Client: components/AppSidebar.tsx:110-112 renders the Messaging link as its title only; the unread total exists only inside FloatingComms (:60).
entries.rationale: Confirmed in code and in runs/qa-member-ines--answer-waiting3/ux.json (item 25 of 26, queue link 30 of 48) and Dara's 14 of 14. Score 2x3x3=18. Same root as pass-02 F01: the 5481acd order rule predates the exchange item types. Lane A: a tier for acts that unblock another person (read_response, approve_collaboration, respond_to_audit) ranked right after overdue items. Lane B: unread count on the sidebar Messaging link.

entries.title: Leaving: 'no approval and no waiting period' contradicts the steward confirmation; nothing says what happens to open posts and conversations
entries.rootCause: client/src/pages/governance/exit/ExitForm.tsx:50-54 says 'no approval and no waiting period' while the confirm dialog (:96-99) says membership ends only when a steward confirms. Neither mentions posts, though api/exit.py:225-226 calls services/exchange.withdraw_on_exit (:653-659) on confirmation, which withdraws open posts with reason 'author left'.
entries.rationale: Confirmed in code and qa-member-dara--exit-file2/exit-filed.png. Lane B: one consistent sentence (nobody can refuse your exit; you stay a member until a steward confirms, at most 30 or 7 days) plus a line that open posts are withdrawn on confirmation and conversations stay in Messages (verify conversations are untouched before writing that).

entries.title: In-app assistant answers 'The assistant is unavailable right now' (Dara)
entries.rootCause: Environment: uxqa/.secrets/stack.env is absent; uxqa/adapter/stack.sh:6-7 loads the model key only from it; api/chat.py:843-847 streams _ASSISTANT_UNAVAILABLE (:51) on the provider exception.
entries.rationale: Same OWNER item.

entries.title: Keyboard focus drops to BODY after deleting a post
entries.rootCause: client/src/pages/discover/PostManageActions.tsx:246-270 DeletePostDialog calls onDeleted, which is the detail dialog's onClose (PostDetailDialog.tsx:105), after the post and its trigger unmount; nothing receives focus. useRefocusOnChange (:37-55) covers status moves, not deletion.
entries.rationale: Confirmed in code and qa-member-ines--reopen-delete2/ux.json. Trivial and the same pattern pass 02 fixed elsewhere (panel F03). Lane B focus sweep: after delete, focus the Shares + Needs list heading.

entries.title: 'Keep it open' has no explanation; only the toast says 'we will ask again in 90 days'
entries.rootCause: client/src/pages/discover/PostManageActions.tsx:167-186 KeepOpen is a bare button (label from allowed_next) with no hint; the 90-day reset is told only after the click.
entries.rationale: Confirmed; trivial. Lane B: a short hint tied to the button with aria-describedby ('Resets the 90-day Still open? check. It keeps taking answers.'). The 90-day cadence for urgent needs is a policy question kept under panel F21.

entries.title: Agreement under review: mixed date formats, no named reviewer, Edit and consent prompt for an ordinary member
entries.rootCause: Dates: same root as p3-health-audit-and-review-11. Edit: AgreementDetail.tsx:135-140 renders Edit unconditionally (fixed under p3-health-audit-and-review-10). Consent prompt: AgreementDetail.tsx:108-109 shows it when the agreement requires explicit consent, the member has not consented and the status is consent-open (under_review is in force), which is by design.
entries.rationale: Date part deferred with health-11; Edit part fixed under health-10; the consent call-to-action is correct for an in-force agreement requiring attestation. Naming the reviewing steward is a LOW enhancement left with health-11's follow-up.

entries.title: Post-publish landing and focus are inconsistent across need, ecosystem and domain posts
entries.rootCause: Landing is by design: client/src/lib/exchange.ts:158-175 publishedNotice sends ecosystem-only posts to the ecosystem page and domain-only posts to the domain page, where their audience sees them. The focus on 'Mark fulfilled' for a need comes from the detail dialog auto-focusing whatever is first once content loads (same root as needs-8).
entries.rationale: Focus part fixed under needs-8 (focus the dialog title). Where restricted posts land is a deliberate visibility rule; long ecosystem pages are not changed in this pass.

entries.title: Post detail opens with focus on Close; a not-found post offers Retry
entries.rootCause: client/src/pages/discover/PostDetailDialog.tsx:116-123: the dialog opens while QueryState shows the loading title, so Radix auto-focuses the only tabbable element, the Close button (components/ui/dialog.tsx:46-50), and keeps it there when the post loads. Retry: components/QueryState.tsx:28,47 always renders Retry on error, including the 404 'Share/Need not found'. Focus to the status line after Respond is deliberate (RespondDialog.tsx:58) and not changed.
entries.rationale: Confirmed in code and qa-new-kofi--postlinks/link-clamps.png. Lane B: move focus to the dialog title once the post loads; the 404 branch is fixed under p3-collaboration-and-moderation-6.

entries.title: Domain picker lists a nameless domain and archived 'Seed Library' duplicates
entries.rootCause: Archived: same root as collaboration-2 (useDomains without a status filter). Nameless DOM-9AECD099: an active Oasis domain with an empty name in neos_uxqa (seed data); lib/domain-label.ts falls back to the code.
entries.rationale: The archived half is fixed under collaboration-2; the nameless domain is fixture data.

entries.title: 'Propose collaboration' on your own offer fixes the partner to your own domain
entries.rootCause: client/src/pages/discover/CollaborationForm.tsx:50 and :157-166 always fix the post's domain as the 'With' side, even when the caller wrote the post; PostDetailDialog.tsx:89-93 offers the button on your own post. The server already accepts the linked post on either side (services/exchange.py:808).
entries.rationale: Confirmed in code and runs/qa-new-tomas--collaboration-and-moderation-4c. No feature removed. Lane B: when fromPost.caller_is_author, fix the post's domain as 'Your domain' and show the 'Domain to work with' picker with the existing hint (start from another ecosystem's post to reach it).

entries.title: Archived domains are offered in the post form and the collaboration 'Your domain' list
entries.rootCause: client/src/pages/discover/SharesNeedsForm.tsx:22 and CollaborationForm.tsx:46 call useDomains({ per_page: '100' }) with no status filter; api/domains.py:245-247 filters by status only when asked. neos_uxqa has 12 archived OmniOne domains. The server does not refuse an archived domain either: services/exchange.py:426-428 publishing_gate loads the domain without a status check.
entries.rationale: Confirmed in code, DB and runs/qa-new-tomas--collaboration-and-moderation-4a/4c/4g. Lane B: request status=active in both forms. Lane A: publishing_gate and propose_collaboration refuse a non-active domain with a plain 409.

entries.title: The collaboration approval item sits near the bottom of a steward's bell and queue
entries.rootCause: neos_agent/services/next_steps.py:1516-1521 approve_collaboration is undated and outside OWNER_ACTIONS, so _queue_order (:837-841) sinks it.
entries.rationale: Same ordering fix (lane A tier).

entries.title: In-app assistant answers 'The assistant is unavailable right now' (Tomas, Lena)
entries.rootCause: Environment: no model key on the study stack (uxqa/.secrets/stack.env absent).
entries.rationale: Same OWNER item.

entries.title: Axe on the collaboration page and /discover: button-name (critical), definition-list, dlitem, list, aria-hidden-focus
entries.rootCause: definition-list and dlitem (6 nodes = 3 dt + 3 dd): client/src/pages/discover/CollaborationDetail.tsx:325-347 nests each dt/dd pair two divs deep beside an icon inside the dl. button-name, list and aria-hidden-focus recur on /dashboard and /discover with the same counts, so they come from the shared shell; nodes not isolated by the run (ux.json records counts only). Confirmed candidate: components/ui/toast.tsx:75-85 ToastClose is an icon-only button with no name.
entries.rationale: Confirmed by runs/qa-new-tomas--collaboration-and-moderation-4g/ux.json and qa-steward-lena--collaboration-and-moderation-4f/ux.json. Lane B: one wrapping div per dt/dd pair (icon inside it); shell nodes handled with p3-gold-signup-orient-3.

entries.title: A hidden or forbidden post reads 'Share/Need not found' with a Retry button; a hidden post's own view says 'Everyone on NEOS'
entries.rootCause: client/src/pages/discover/PostDetailDialog.tsx:117-124 renders QueryState's generic error, whose Retry is unconditional (components/QueryState.tsx:47), for the 404 the server returns on a post the caller may not see. The 'Who can see it' row (:43-49) shows the stored visibility on a hidden post without saying it is hidden from every list.
entries.rationale: Confirmed in code and runs/qa-new-tomas--collaboration-and-moderation-3f. Trivial. Lane B: a 404 shows 'This post is no longer available to you' with no Retry; on a hidden post the visibility row reads hidden (author and stewards only).

entries.title: The proposer and both sides hear nothing when a collaboration becomes active or ends
entries.rootCause: By design today: the bell and queue are next_steps.waiting_for (services/next_steps.py:844-912), which holds only acts the caller can take; there is no informational item type, and services/notifications.py only sends Web Push (notify_members has no caller).
entries.rationale: Not a defect in an existing feature: it asks for a new informational channel. Owner question plus human validation (do proposers expect to be told?). Panel F06 merges here.
entries.ownerQuestion: Should the bell carry informational items (your collaboration became active or ended, your exit was confirmed) alongside the things waiting for you, and for how long?

entries.title: Approval state names no approving stewards; an ended collaboration still shows a review date
entries.rootCause: client/src/pages/discover/CollaborationDetail.tsx:333-339 renders 'Review date' for every status, including completed and dissolved. Naming the stewards who can approve needs data the payload lacks.
entries.rationale: Review-date half confirmed and trivial: Lane B shows it only while proposed or active. Naming approvers is deferred (needs a server field and a privacy check on listing stewards).

entries.title: Stuck-newcomer wording conflicts: the queue says a steward confirms, the page says nobody needs approval, and the newcomer can finish it alone
entries.rootCause: neos_agent/services/next_steps.py:1355-1360 tells the steward 'so a steward confirms them', but the newcomer can finish alone: ConsentGatePage.tsx:105-117 'Check my membership' re-joins and services/member_lifecycle.py:184 activates with GATE_CLEARED.
entries.rationale: Confirmed in code and runs/qa-steward-amara--collaboration-and-moderation-1/1b. Trivial copy. Lane A: the item's why says to ask the newcomer to press Check my membership on their consent page, or confirm them on their member page. Panel F15 merges here.

entries.title: Pending newcomer sees 'Manage Quizzes' and a '0 ecosystems' header; a kept-in-force agreement keeps its Sunset Date
entries.rootCause: client/src/hooks/usePermissions.tsx:26-37 grants manage_content to the townhall and collaborator profiles, so AppSidebar.tsx:116-122 and :250 show Manage Quizzes, while the server refuses quiz authoring to anyone but stewards (api/quizzes.py:68-70 can_manage_onboarding). EcosystemPicker.tsx:49-54 prints '0 ecosystems' when nothing is selectable. Sunset: api/agreements.py:457-458 renewing sets the next review and leaves sunset_date alone.
entries.rationale: Nav and header halves confirmed and trivial. Lane B: Manage Quizzes follows the server's steward rule, as Newcomers does (showsNewcomers); the picker names the pending ecosystem instead of '0 ecosystems'. The sunset half is policy (a planned sunset clause may legitimately survive a renewal) and goes to the owner.
entries.ownerQuestion: When stewards keep an agreement in force at review, should an earlier planned sunset date be cleared?

entries.title: A steward cannot tell why there is no 'Record an audit'; Audit History's 'Record an audit' loops back to Safeguards
entries.rootCause: api/safeguards.py:212-232 sends only caller_can_record_audit (a boolean) although auditor_refusal (:436-443) already holds the reason (AUDITOR_NOT_INDEPENDENT); client SafeguardsDashboard.tsx:150-156 hides the button and says nothing; AuditList.tsx:83-85 links 'Record an audit' to /safeguards for everyone.
entries.rationale: Confirmed in code and runs/qa-member-oren--health-audit-and-review-1 (15-record-audit-retry.out.txt: HREF /safeguards, no self-assessment text). The refusal is correct; the silence is the defect. Rescored 2x2x2=8: stewards only, and the act is correctly refused. Lane A: add caller_record_audit_refusal (plain message or null) per ecosystem entry. Lane B: render it on the card with the next step (ask an active member who is not a steward); AuditList offers the link only when some ecosystem allows recording, and says where recording starts.

entries.title: OWNER: the in-app assistant answers 'The assistant is unavailable right now' on the study stack (no model key)
entries.rootCause: Environment: uxqa/.secrets/stack.env does not exist (checked), and uxqa/adapter/stack.sh:6-7 loads AI_API_KEY only from it; api/chat.py:843-847 streams the plain unavailable message (:51) after the provider exception and saves no session (_save_session at :827 is skipped). No code defect.
entries.rationale: Third pass blocked: all assistant steps in four lanes and all 25 agent evals (agent-eval.json aborted OWNER_BLOCKED). Same as p2-stewards-confirm-and-register-3 (OPEN). Owner puts AI_API_KEY in uxqa/.secrets/stack.env before pass 04.
entries.ownerQuestion: Provide the study stack's model key in uxqa/.secrets/stack.env (AI_API_KEY, AI_PROVIDER) so assistant lanes and agent evals can run.

entries.title: Audit form offers 'Yes, publish' with required indicators unrated; tooltip says one rating is enough; 'Still to rate' lists GHI codes
entries.rootCause: client/src/components/governance/safeguards/GovernanceHealthAuditForm.tsx:247-255 enables Publish and 'Yes, publish' once one rating exists and titles it 'Rate at least one indicator first'; :229 lists missingRequired as ids (GHI-05) that the form never shows. The server refuses correctly: api/safeguards.py:474-477 RATINGS_MISSING names the indicators.
entries.rationale: Confirmed in code and qa-new-priya--health-audit-and-review-2 (06, 07). Not a data-integrity defect (server enforces), so panel F10's HIGH condition does not hold. Lane B: Publish stays unavailable until every required indicator is rated, with one message naming them by their form names; tooltip states the same rule.

entries.title: A reversed audit period blanks every value and required marker behind a generic load error, and still offers publishing
entries.rootCause: GovernanceHealthAuditForm.tsx:176-182 has no from/to validation; the snapshot 400 ('from must be on or before to', api/safeguards.py:262) shows as 'The live values could not be loaded' (:187), and requiredIds comes from snapshot data (:89-90), so markers and the Still-to-rate list vanish. Publish itself is refused server-side (safeguards.py:467-468).
entries.rationale: Confirmed in code and qa-new-priya--health-audit-and-review-2/08-period-inverted-viewport.png. Lane B: a field error on Period to (aria-invalid, aria-describedby), keep the last good values and markers, and block Publish while the period is invalid.

entries.title: Neither the audit dialog nor the published audit page names the audited ecosystem
entries.rootCause: GovernanceHealthAuditForm.tsx:147-150 title is 'Record a governance health audit'; pages/governance/safeguards/AuditDetail.tsx:101 H1 is 'Governance Audit'; api/safeguards.py:138-167 _audit_to_detail returns ecosystem_id but no name.
entries.rationale: Confirmed in code and qa-new-priya--health-audit-and-review-2/04, -4/02. Lane A: ecosystem_name on AuditDetail (schema + _audit_to_detail). Lane B: 'Record a governance health audit of {ecosystem}' and 'Governance audit of {ecosystem}'.

entries.title: Headline scores over all-'No data' indicators, contradictory dates on the seeded audit, and 'DEGRADING' on a first measurement
entries.rootCause: Mostly seed: neos_uxqa's four seeded audits are 'completed' with a score but no indicator_scores and no next_audit_due. Code parts: 'DEGRADING' is not a trend but the overall band for a score of 25-49 (api/safeguards.py:58-68), shown as a bare badge next to per-indicator trends (AuditDetail.tsx:105-107); completed_at is updated_at (safeguards.py:149), so any later write moves 'Completed'.
entries.rationale: The lane misread the badge, but the confusion is real. Lane B: show the band as 'Overall: Weak (25-49)' or similar, never a word that reads as a trend. Lane A: completed_at = the publish date. Seed half deferred to the uxqa prebake (seed audits with frozen indicator rows and next_audit_due), not a code change.

entries.title: Computed values and auditor ratings look alike outside the form
entries.rootCause: client/src/pages/governance/safeguards/SafeguardsDashboard.tsx:184-187 prints bandLabel(indicator.band) beside the value like a verdict; AuditDetail.tsx:217 shows the auditor's status as an unlabelled badge above 'Framework band: ...' (:228). The form already separates them (GovernanceHealthAuditForm.tsx:200-201).
entries.rationale: Confirmed in code and screenshots (11-safeguards.png, 12-published-audit.png). Lane B: 'Framework band: X' on Safeguards tiles; 'Auditor's rating: X' on the audit page; one plain intro sentence on Safeguards saying what is counted by the app and what the auditor rates (covers plain-words-6).

entries.title: The stewards' prompt to respond to a critical audit lands last in the queue and bell
entries.rootCause: neos_agent/services/next_steps.py:1207-1211 respond_to_audit is undated and outside OWNER_ACTIONS; _queue_order (:837-841).
entries.rationale: Same ordering fix.

entries.title: 'N Agreement reviews overdue' opens the unfiltered list; list cards show no review date
entries.rootCause: neos_agent/services/health.py:349-350 links the count to '/agreements'; api/agreements.py:100-130 _apply_filters has no review filter; client AgreementList.tsx:83 shows only a 'Review overdue' badge and no review date, although the list item carries review_date (agreements.py:156).
entries.rationale: Confirmed in code and qa-new-priya--health-audit-and-review-4/05, 06. Lane A: a review=overdue filter using the review_overdue rule (:163-165) and the attention link '/agreements?review=overdue'. Lane B: AgreementList reads the param into its filters and shows the next review date on in-force cards.

entries.title: A plain member is offered Edit and the full edit form on an in-force agreement
entries.rootCause: client/src/pages/governance/agreements/AgreementDetail.tsx:135-140 renders Edit for every viewer and every status. The server refuses: api/agreements.py:680-681 returns 409 for anything but draft or advice, and :677-678 requires an active member, so the BLOCKER condition does not hold.
entries.rationale: Confirmed; a dead end that implies authority the member lacks. Lane B: show Edit only for draft or advice agreements to an active member (the server rule); in force, 'Propose a change' stays. Note for the owner: in draft or advice, any active member may edit (agreements.py:677-681).
entries.ownerQuestion: In draft and advice, should any active member be able to edit an agreement's text, or only its proposer and stewards?

entries.title: The same date reads three or four ways on one page, with ISO dates inside sentences
entries.rootCause: Server sentences format ISO dates (neos_agent/services/next_steps.py:1208 and :1253 audit_date.isoformat()), while client detail rows use formatDate (lib/utils) and status boxes use a long form.
entries.rationale: Real, but a cross-cutting sweep (one date contract between server sentences and the client formatter across every explain() banner), not trivial. Deferred to a shared-date-formatter follow-up; no misreading risk observed.
entries.deferredTo: shared date formatter follow-up (server explain() sentences plus client lib/utils formatDate)

entries.title: Focus drops to the page body after publishing an audit and after recording the stewards' response
entries.rootCause: SafeguardsDashboard.tsx:254-259 opens GovernanceHealthAuditForm as a controlled dialog with no DialogTrigger, so Radix has no element to return focus to; AuditStewardActions.tsx:111-112 likewise keeps its button outside the Dialog, and the button unmounts once the response exists.
entries.rationale: Confirmed in code and flows/health-audit-and-review j2-priya/11, j3-oren/09. Same pattern pass 02 fixed. Lane B focus sweep: focus the result (the published audit card or the recorded response heading).

entries.title: Ratification table clipped and not keyboard-scrollable; seeded in-force agreements show pending ACT gates
entries.rootCause: components/ui/table.tsx:9 wraps every table in an overflow-auto div with no tabIndex, so the scroll region is unreachable by keyboard (axe scrollable-region-focusable in runs/qa-member-oren--health-audit-and-review-1/ux.json); AgreementDetail.tsx:543-561 is the clipped table. Pending gates: seeded agreements have no ACT records and ActGatesPanel.tsx:105-113 says complete only by status.
entries.rationale: Scroll region: an impact-3 keyboard barrier (the DATE column cannot be reached), lifted to MEDIUM by the accessibility exception (panel F22). Lane B: focusable, labelled scroll region in ui/table.tsx. The seeded-gates half needs a rule for agreements ratified before NEOS recorded stages; deferred to the owner with the newcomer-language question (plain-words-5).

entries.title: Raw enum values shown to members: 'Under_review', 'Audit Scope: full'
entries.rootCause: client/src/pages/Dashboard.tsx:62-64 prints the breakdown key with CSS capitalize, so 'under_review' reads 'Under_review'; AuditDetail.tsx:158-161 prints audit_scope raw while the form says 'Full review' (GovernanceHealthAuditForm.tsx:169-171). GHI codes in the confirm text are fixed under health-3.
entries.rationale: Confirmed; trivial. Lane B: human labels from the existing vocab helpers.

entries.title: Oren's ecosystem selector says 'No new ecosystems to discover' while Priya's lists two
entries.rootCause: Not confirmed: EcosystemPicker.tsx:36-45 lists public ecosystems from the discover feed minus the caller's memberships, and api/discover.py:160-189 filters only on visibility='public'. neos_uxqa: Escherbridge and Plan Systems are public and Oren has only an OmniOne row, so the code path should list them; the difference is not explained by reading.
entries.rationale: Reproduce as Oren with the network panel open (is the discover request empty, failing, or paged?) before any change.

entries.title: A taken username switches the page to the Sign In form and drops the typed sign-up values
entries.rootCause: client/src/contexts/AuthContext.tsx:167-178 register sets the global isLoading; App.tsx:449-451 then renders LoadingScreen instead of the routes, unmounting Login; on the 409 Login remounts with authMode 'password' (Login.tsx:52) and empty fields. The same path drops typed values on a failed sign-in (login, :153-163).
entries.rationale: Confirmed in code and runs/anon--plain-words-and-joining-5/mateo-31-taken-username.png. Lane B: sign-in and sign-up keep the auth check's isLoading for the session check only and use the form's own submitting state, so Login stays mounted; the 409 shows on the username field (aria-invalid).

entries.title: A public ecosystem's page is a sign-in wall for signed-out visitors
entries.rootCause: By design today: client/src/App.tsx:445 public paths are /login, /about, /governance-model and /users/ only, so /ethos/:id redirects to /login; 'public' visibility means visible to anyone signed in to NEOS (panel F07).
entries.rationale: Whether signed-out visitors may read a public ecosystem's page is policy. Cheap follow-up either way: the login page could name the ecosystem the link was for.
entries.ownerQuestion: Should an ecosystem with public visibility show its ethos page and how to join to visitors who are not signed in?

entries.title: Reply conversations are titled 'Re: <post>' with no responder name
entries.rootCause: neos_agent/services/exchange.py:638-639 titles each answer's conversation 'Re: {post title}'; client/src/lib/conversation-title.ts:10 returns any stored title as is, so the participant name is never shown (MessagingLayout.tsx:120, FloatingComms.tsx:412).
entries.rationale: Confirmed in code and runs/qa-new-joy--plain-words-and-joining-8 text capture. Lane B: for a two-person conversation with a stored title, prefix the other participant's name ('Rafi Haddad: Re: ...'); table-driven test in conversation-title.

entries.title: The post card never says who can see a public post
entries.rootCause: client/src/pages/discover/PostParts.tsx:12 and :22-23 render the visibility badge only when visibility is not public, so a public post's card states nothing; the detail dialog has it (PostDetailDialog.tsx:43-49).
entries.rationale: Confirmed in code and runs/qa-new-joy--plain-words-and-joining-1 (joy-03-after-publish.png). Lane B: show the visibility badge on every card, in the form's words ('Everyone on NEOS'). Panel F07 merges here.

entries.title: The agreement page a newcomer reads before consenting is full of ACT vocabulary
entries.rootCause: AgreementDetail.tsx renders ActGatesPanel, Ceremonies and participation gates for every viewer. Two reported symptoms are text-capture artefacts: ActGatesPanel.tsx:105-113 renders the full sentence after 'Gates declared at this record.', and AgreementDetail.tsx:126-130 puts the version in its own element below the title.
entries.rationale: A content-design choice, not a broken feature; restructuring what newcomers see needs evidence. Human sessions with newcomers on a phone: can they say what consenting commits them to? Kill if 4 of 5 can.

entries.title: The Safeguards page reads as expert output to a low-literacy member
entries.rootCause: SafeguardsDashboard.tsx:174-176 and :184-187: one reference sentence, then computed bands that read as verdicts.
entries.rationale: health-7's fix adds the plain intro (what the page is, what the app counts, what the auditor rates) and labels both kinds of value.

entries.title: The first domain option is a seeded test domain that appears on public posts
entries.rootCause: The 'Seed Library (uxqa-p0 agent-eval ...)' options are archived OmniOne domains offered by the unfiltered useDomains call (SharesNeedsForm.tsx:22).
entries.rationale: Fixed by offering active domains only; the 'what is a domain' hint is a LOW content follow-up.

entries.title: On a phone, Discover and other navigation sit behind 'Toggle Sidebar'
entries.rootCause: client/src/App.tsx:493 SidebarTrigger is an icon button named by sr-only 'Toggle Sidebar' (components/ui/sidebar.tsx:276-277); the offcanvas sidebar is the standard mobile pattern.
entries.rationale: Mateo opened the menu and reached Discover. A visible 'Menu' label or a bottom bar is a mobile navigation design decision, not a trivial fix.

entries.title: Continue with Google fails with redirect_uri_mismatch on the study stack
entries.rootCause: Environment: the Google OAuth client is not registered for the study stack's localhost:5173 callback. No code defect found.
entries.rationale: Owner either registers the study callback or the stack hides providers it has no client for.
entries.ownerQuestion: Register the study stack's OAuth callback with Google, or hide Google sign-in where no client is configured?

entries.title: 'Post a share or need' is clipped at 1366 px
entries.rootCause: client/src/pages/discover/SharesNeedsList.tsx:156-161 gives the button lg:col-span-2 of a 12-column grid, about 175 px beside the 16 rem sidebar, narrower than its label.
entries.rationale: Confirmed in code and runs/qa-gold-member--gold-share-stale-driver-run1/shares-tab.png. Trivial: Lane B lets the button take the width it needs and the filters wrap.

entries.title: Success toasts cover the ACT Gates card on the proposal page
entries.rootCause: Toast viewport placement is global (components/ui/toast.tsx viewport); toasts overlay content for a few seconds by design.
entries.rationale: Moving the global toast position affects every page; not trivial. Deferred with the toast accessibility work.

entries.title: A new member's queue lists the entry quiz before the orientation journey it quizzes
entries.rootCause: neos_agent/services/next_steps.py:1386-1397 builds both first-month items with kind 'newcomer', undated and not owner actions, so _queue_order (:840-841) breaks the tie by title: 'Take OmniOne Onboarding Readiness' sorts before 'Walk through OmniOne's orientation'.
entries.rationale: Confirmed in code and runs/qa-gold-newcomer--gold-orient (dashboard.png, ux.json: quiz first, 6 failed attempts). Lane A: an explicit order so the journey precedes the quiz, and the quiz item says to take it after the orientation journey (with its link).

entries.title: A brand-new account's dashboard shows a 23-item queue and a '9+' bell with no first-steps area
entries.rootCause: The size is fixture residue (uxqa-p1/p2/p3 proposals the new member may advise on, by design: an active member may give advice). There is no separate 'Getting started' section; first-month items are queue items (next_steps.py:1364-1398).
entries.rationale: The ordering half is fixed under gold-signup-orient-1. Whether a separate first-steps area helps is a design hypothesis for human sessions on a realistic, non-fixture queue.

entries.title: Axe on /dashboard: button-name (critical), aria-hidden-focus (2), list (1)
entries.rootCause: ux.json (runs/qa-visitor--gold-signup-run1..3) records the rules and counts but not the nodes. The same counts appear on /discover and the collaboration page, so the source is the shared shell. Confirmed nameless control: components/ui/toast.tsx:75-85 ToastClose (icon only, no aria-label), present right after sign-up's 'Account Created' toast. The pass-02 logout node is fixed (AppSidebar.tsx:493-498), so this is a different node.
entries.rationale: Third pass with button-name. Lane B: run axe with node targets at 1366 and 390 px on /dashboard, /discover and a collaboration page, with and without a toast; name every node in the commit; fix each (ToastClose gets 'Dismiss notification'); if aria-hidden-focus is Radix Toast's focus proxies, record it as a library limitation instead of patching vendor code; add a cheap regression check for button-name.

entries.title: The login page logs a 401 console error from the session check
entries.rootCause: The browser itself logs 'Failed to load resource: 401' for GET /api/v1/auth/me; the app does not log it (no console.error in contexts/AuthContext.tsx). A 401 is the correct answer for a signed-out session check.
entries.rationale: Expected behaviour; silencing it would mean changing the auth contract to 200-with-anonymous, which is not warranted.

entries.title: Assistant refusals for hide-a-post and record-an-audit could not be verified: no reply, no session stored
entries.rootCause: api/chat.py:843-847: when the provider fails (no model key) the stream appends the unavailable message and ends without _save_session (:827), so GET /chat/sessions is empty. GET showed the ladder post unhidden and the audit count unchanged, so no write happened.
entries.rationale: Re-run the two refusal probes once the owner supplies the key.

entries.title: Assistant eval R1 (read) ERROR: OWNER_BLOCKED
entries.rootCause: agent-evals/transcripts/R1-1.json: 'The assistant is unavailable right now' with no tool calls; the runner aborted OWNER_BLOCKED, and the other 24 tasks were skipped. No product defect.
entries.rationale: Same OWNER item. Synthesis section 10: even when unblocked, none of the 25 tasks covers shares, needs, collaborations, moderation or audits.

entries.title: Re-check: axe button-name (critical, 1 node) still on /dashboard
entries.rootCause: The pass-02 node (collapsed-sidebar Logout) is fixed: components/AppSidebar.tsx:493-498 has aria-label. A different node remains; candidate components/ui/toast.tsx:75-85.
entries.rationale: Tracked under gold-signup-orient-3, which names the nodes and adds a regression check.

entries.title: Panel: the bell and queue bury answers and approvals; Messaging has no unread count
entries.rationale: Confirmed in code; fixed through the lane item.

entries.title: Panel: consent gives no 'you are in' moment; activation seems to wait for a re-check
entries.rootCause: Hypothesis refuted in part: consenting to the last required agreement activates at once (api/agreements.py:860-866, CONSENT_ACTIVATED). Tomas's stuck state is the separate 'gate emptied' case, finished by Check my membership (member_lifecycle.py:184). The 'you are in' moment after consenting is a page-flow question.
entries.rationale: Human sessions: after consenting, can a newcomer say whether they are a member? Kill if 4 of 5 can. Steward copy contradiction fixed under p3-collaboration-and-moderation-9.

entries.title: Panel: focus lost after publish, delete and reopen
entries.rootCause: PostManageActions.tsx:246-270; PostDetailDialog.tsx:116-123; SafeguardsDashboard.tsx:254-259; AuditStewardActions.tsx:111-112.
entries.rationale: Lane B focus sweep (needs-4, needs-8, health-12).

entries.title: Panel: button-name (critical) on /dashboard, /discover and the collaboration page
entries.rootCause: Shared-shell node not isolated; candidate components/ui/toast.tsx:75-85.
entries.rationale: Fixed with node identification and a regression check.

entries.title: Panel: unstable exchange vocabulary; 'Respond' in the scenario, 'Offer help' in the UI
entries.rootCause: No defect confirmed: every persona who used the UI's own labels completed; gold-respond 1/6 is the harness (a 'Respond' locator that does not exist, strict-mode collisions, a reused fixture).
entries.rationale: Human sessions: do 2 of 5 members press 'Propose collaboration' to reply? If yes, rename. Fix the gold-respond driver to use the UI label.

entries.title: Panel: Active, Completed and exit outcomes raise no item for the people affected
entries.rootCause: next_steps.waiting_for holds actionable items only (services/next_steps.py:844-912).
entries.rationale: Owner question on informational items.

entries.title: Panel: post visibility is clear to the poster but not to the reader
entries.rootCause: PostParts.tsx:22-23 (no badge on public posts); PostDetailDialog.tsx:117-124 (generic not-found).
entries.rationale: Card badge fixed under plain-words-4; not-found wording under collaboration-6; 'public means signed-in' is the owner question under plain-words-2.

entries.title: Panel: the dashboard ranks the entry quiz above the orientation journey
entries.rootCause: next_steps.py:840-841 title tie-break over :1386-1397.
entries.rationale: Confirmed; fixed through the lane item. Re-run gold-orient with a goal-driven choice.

entries.title: Panel: sign-up errors are late and confusing
entries.rootCause: AuthContext.tsx:167-178 with App.tsx:449-451 remount Login on submit; Login.tsx:164-172 checks rules only on submit.
entries.rationale: Remount fixed under plain-words-1; OAuth dead end is the environment item plain-words-9.

entries.title: Panel: an audit can be published incomplete; reversed period blanks values; refused steward gets no reason; no ecosystem name
entries.rootCause: The publish endpoint refuses missing ratings (api/safeguards.py:474-477) and a reversed period (:467-468), so the data-integrity condition for HIGH does not hold; the UI parts are confirmed.
entries.rationale: Fixed through health-1, -3, -4 and -5.

entries.title: Panel: proposing from your own offer fixes the partner side
entries.rootCause: CollaborationForm.tsx:157-166.
entries.rationale: Fixed through the lane item.

entries.title: Panel: the assistant is unavailable on the first message
entries.rootCause: Missing model key on the study stack.
entries.rationale: OWNER.

entries.title: Panel: sign-in jargon ('Identity protocol', 'Advanced: sign in with DID'), not localised for es-US
entries.rootCause: Copy confirmed (client/src/pages/Login.tsx:237 'Identity protocol'); the client has no localisation layer, so es-US is unsupported, not broken.
entries.rationale: Every sign-up completed. Owner decides supported locales; human sessions test whether the eyebrow copy slows sign-up.

entries.title: Panel: 'Post a share or nee' clipped; the Guide tab overlays cards
entries.rootCause: SharesNeedsList.tsx:156-161; Guide tab is fixed-position (RouteGuidePanel.tsx:87-99).
entries.rationale: Clipping fixed; the Guide overlay is left for human checks at 1366 and 390 px.

entries.title: Panel: Newcomers page says 'nobody needs your approval' and 'confirm the membership'
entries.rootCause: next_steps.py:1355-1360.
entries.rationale: Copy fixed through the lane item.

entries.title: Panel: a filed exit does not say you are still a member or what happens to your posts
entries.rootCause: ExitForm.tsx:50-54, :96-99.

entries.title: Panel: invalid list and dl markup and focusable aria-hidden elements
entries.rootCause: CollaborationDetail.tsx:325-347; shell nodes under gold-signup-orient-3.

entries.title: Panel: pointer and URL fallbacks in keyboard-only runs (Withdraw, Discover)
entries.rootCause: Not confirmed: Withdraw is a Button in an AlertDialogTrigger (PostManageActions.tsx:139-141), reachable by Tab; probably the rig.
entries.rationale: Kill if a human reaches Withdraw and Discover by Tab alone.

entries.title: Panel: mixed date formats and languages; no named reviewer; unfiltered overdue link
entries.rootCause: next_steps.py:1208, :1253 isoformat; health.py:349-350.
entries.rationale: Dates deferred with health-11; the overdue link is fixed under health-9.

entries.title: Panel: fulfil cannot credit offline or multiple helpers
entries.rootCause: By design: PostManageActions.tsx:100-115 lists responders plus 'Someone else, or I'd rather not say'.
entries.rationale: Joy credited Rafi correctly. Owner question whether naming offline or several helpers matters.

entries.title: Panel: one 90-day 'still open?' cadence for every post; no urgency field
entries.rootCause: services/exchange STALE_AFTER_DAYS used at next_steps.py:1473-1478.
entries.rationale: The explanation is fixed under needs-5; cadence or urgency is an owner question.

entries.title: Panel: a scroll region on the agreement page is not keyboard-focusable
entries.rootCause: components/ui/table.tsx:9 (the Ratification Records table wrapper), not the agreement text as the panel guessed.
entries.rationale: Fixed in the shared table component.
